item.title: CVE-2026-77377 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.2
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.2 | Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.4, the authenticated URL-upload endpoint and authenticated embed endpoint fetch user-supplied URLs server-side without protection against internal targets, allowing an attacker with the applicable backend permission to cause the Bolt server to request those targets. item.title: CVE-2026-77380 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.2
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.2 | Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.5, the /bolt/async/upload-url and /bolt/async/embed endpoints validate only a submitted URL before fetching it server-side. item.title: CVE-2026-77382 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | falcon-rust is a Rust implementation of the Falcon post-quantum signature scheme. Prior to 0.2.0, the discrete-Gaussian sampler in src/samplerz.rs evaluates approx_exp, ber_exp, and sampler_z acceptance probabilities with FixedPoint64 values having only 32 fractional bits. The scaling in approx_exp quantizes its input and limits relative precision to about 2^-33, below Falcon's required bound, causing reference known-answer vectors to diverge and invalidating the proof assumption that secret-dependent signature and key distributions are negligibly close to the ideal discrete Gaussian. This is a cryptographic-soundness defect and no practical key-recovery attack has been demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 0.2.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-115515 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | @fastify/static is the Fastify plugin for serving static files. In versions before 10.1.8, the allowedPath guard receives only the requested pathname, but the underlying send step selects the file to serve afterwards, so a request for a directory resolves to its default index file and an extensionless request resolves through the configured extensions to a matching file. The selected file is streamed without being re-checked against allowedPath, so a guard that denies a specific file is bypassed by requesting its directory or extensionless form. An unauthenticated client can read files inside the static root that the application meant to keep private whenever the denied file is reachable as a directory index or an extension match. The issue is fixed in @fastify/static 10.1.8, and users should upgrade to 10.1.8 or later. As a workaround, also deny the directory and extensionless forms in allowedPath, or disable the index and extensions options.

item.title: CVE-2026-128135 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.1 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.9.4 to 3.10.3, NLTK ZIP package extraction can write through an existing in-root hardlink whose other link points outside the NLTK data root. A local attacker who can prepare the extraction target can cause a package member write to overwrite an out-of-root file, violating the pathsec containment boundary and affecting integrity and availability. This issues is fixed in version 3.10.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-128136 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. item.title: CVE-2026-128138 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.10.3 until 3.10.4, the NLTK 3.10.3 JVM hardening validates Java launcher tokens in the options channel but appends the caller-controlled cmd sequence without requiring its first token to be a main class. Supplying -jar or an @argfile through nltk.internals.java or StanfordSegmenter.java_class can therefore execute attacker-selected Java bytecode without the unsafe-JAR opt-in. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-128139 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.6 to 3.10.3, XMLCorpusView._read_xml_fragment accumulates 1 KiB blocks and repeatedly applies whole-buffer XML validation while a comment or CDATA terminator remains ahead. A large comment in an attacker-controlled corpus file causes quadratic CPU consumption through documented XML corpus readers across the affected range. On 3.6 and 3.9.2, a large CDATA section incurs the quadratic scan before rejection, while on 3.10.3 both comment and CDATA documents are read successfully. This vulnerability is fixed in 3.10.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-128140 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.6.7 until 3.10.4, nltk.downloader follows collection membership without tracking already visited collection nodes. A self-referencing or mutually referencing collection index can therefore make the package-closure walk loop indefinitely while its queue and memory usage grow, denying service when a victim processes the attacker-influenced index. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-129222 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. item.title: CVE-2026-129223 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, WordNet Synset.tree and acyclic_tree traverse relation graphs through recursive utility helpers without a depth bound. Exploitation requires the host application to load an attacker-influenced custom or foreign WordNet-format lexical resource; no relation in NLTK's bundled WordNet 3.0 corpus reaches the crash threshold. An excessively deep relation graph in such a resource can exceed the Python recursion limit and terminate the traversal or request worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

A deeply chained or cyclic attacker-controlled CoNLL or Malt-TAB dependency structure can raise RecursionError and abort a parse worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-129229 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.10.0 until 3.10.4, TokenSearcher.findall and Text.findall accept caller-controlled regular expressions with an unbounded number of capturing groups throughout the affected range. Starting in 3.10.3, nltk.redos.compile and RegexpTokenizer expose the same compile-time vector. The third-party regex engine compiles group-dense patterns with roughly quadratic cost before the match-time timeout begins, allowing a small unauthenticated request to exhaust CPU and deny service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-129231 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. item.title: CVE-2026-129233 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.10.0 until 3.10.4, StreamBackedCorpusView performs os.stat on a caller-supplied plain string path during construction before pathsec containment is enforced. That string can identify an out-of-root path and disclose its existence, size, and modification time even though opening the file would be rejected. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-130811 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | @fastify/static is the Fastify plugin for serving static files. In versions up to and including 10.1.11, when it is configured to deny or ignore dotfiles together with directory listing enabled, a request for a denied dot-directory returns its directory listing instead of being refused. The underlying send step answers with a forbidden response, but the listing fallback misreads that response on a path ending in a slash as a directory without an index file and serves the listing anyway. An unauthenticated client can enumerate the names of files and subdirectories, recursively, inside dot-directories the operator explicitly denied, such as version control, backup, and key file names. File contents remain protected and only names are disclosed. The issue is fixed in @fastify/static 10.1.12, and users should upgrade to 10.1.12 or later. As a workaround, disable directory listing or do not serve a root that contains dot-directories.

item.title: CVE-2026-133221 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | A flaw was found in Keycloak. An authenticated remote user with a pending required security action, such as configuring multi-factor authentication (MFA), can bypass the mandatory action by submitting a specially crafted request to the consent endpoint without a valid session code. Keycloak incorrectly interprets the submission as a page refresh and completes the authentication process, allowing the user to access the application without fulfilling the required security policies.

item.title: CVE-2026-22308 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | The preview mode of the OPC (OnPage Composer) page builder of JTL-Shop is activated by a request parameter alone and renders page data supplied in the request without checking for an authenticated backend session with the corresponding permission. Several portlet properties are output without output encoding. An unauthenticated remote attacker can thereby cause script code to be executed in the browser of a visitor or administrator who opens a crafted link; in the case of an administrator, actions can be performed with the administrator's privileges. Third-party plugins whose portlets evaluate property values as templates can additionally be made to execute template code through the same entry point. This is a separate flaw in such plugins and does not affect the portlets of JTL-Shop itself.
